title: Moving On
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Moving On,' the office faces conflicts and revelations: David confronts Andy about lying, Erin reveals her relationship with Pete, and Andy reacts strongly to this news. Meanwhile, Dwight and Angela visit Aunt Shirley, and Toby plans to visit a prison to discuss the Scranton Strangler case. The episode explores themes of honesty, relationships, and moving forward amidst workplace tensions.
